decision_note: Reversed on 2026-08-06 (D-175). The payload describes a page title, not a realization: its corpus record rr_d6d2a2a98095047fc3acc42a holds a 99-character observation — the 2015 Duolingo capture was JS-rendered, so tag-stripping in realization-wayback yielded essentially the <title>, and this quote is 82 of those 99 characters. It names no trigger, no interface change and nothing ZE-07 is about. The defect is the connector's 40-character floor accepting a page title as interface evidence, not this proposal, which reports its source faithfully. Approved by the owner on 2026-07-24 and rejected here by the same authority; the approval stands in the decision log as what was believed at the time.
